There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings.

WHAT WAS AUTHORED: a configuration-only ROS 1 RosDriver for the pinned Gazebo/MoveIt topic graph. Primary control is x-cap.ad-sdl.arm_pose_goal.v1, one geometry_msgs/Pose publication to /ur_arm/moveit/goal_pose (sdl_gazebo/src/sdl_moveit_node.py:136). The package also publishes a geometry_msgs/PoseStamped navigation goal to /move_base_simple/goal (sdl_gazebo/python-nodes/can_demo_no_camera.py:18) and std_msgs/Float64 positions to the left and right gripper controller topics (can_demo_no_camera.py:20-21). Resource reads and explicit observation actions subscribe to /move_group/status and /move_base/status with actionlib_msgs/GoalStatusArray (can_demo.py:20, can_demo_no_camera.py:29). There is no Python native class and no native.py. The fake is a ROS-free RecordingRosTransport; its status samples, goal ids and recorded messages are placeholders.

WHY THE HELPER CANNOT COMPLETE THE CONTROL SURFACE: the clone's only stop call is self.group.stop() at sdl_gazebo/src/sdl_moveit_node.py:119, after the blocking self.group.go(wait=True) returns inside the same goal callback (lines 114-122). It is not a ROS service or action. The clone contains no std_srvs import, no ROS service declaration and no stop action; ros_controllers.yaml names ur_arm_controller with only the short FollowJointTrajectory type (ros_controllers.yaml:29-40), and move_group.launch starts the node without declaring a stop endpoint (move_group.launch:59-60). The only other stop-like text is the README instruction to press play in the Gazebo GUI (README.md:57-62), which is not a ROS endpoint. A zero-velocity or repeat-pose publication is transmission only and is not accepted as an acknowledged stop. The package therefore leaves safety_bindings empty and declares no safe-state action instead of fabricating one; G6 and G8 report SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED. This is an upstream stop gap, not a fake defect.

LIMITS: every numeric arm, base and gripper input is Limit.operator_required. The clone states one example arm pose (README.md:81-89) and one gripper open/close sequence (can_demo_no_camera.py:103-113), not a workspace, navigation or stroke envelope, so the operator supplies each bound. site-limits.example.json is an illustrative operator overlay, not a device fact; [...]
